scenario.name: GB200 and GB300 shared-resource reconciliation
scenario.notes: NVIDIA rack requirements are source-backed where disclosed. Shared capacity, demand, allocation priority, yield, qualification, logistics, installation, and commissioning inputs are synthetic.

evidence.title: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 product specifications
evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA reports 72 Blackwell GPUs, 36 Grace CPUs, 13.4 TB HBM3E, and a liquid-cooled rack-scale design.

evidence.title: NVIDIA DGX GB Rack Scale Systems hardware guide
evidence.excerpt: The guide reports 18 compute trays, 9 NVLink switch trays, 8 power shelves, and approximately 120 kW rack consumption.

evidence.title: NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 product specifications
evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA reports 72 Blackwell Ultra GPUs, 36 Grace CPUs, and 20 TB of GPU memory in a liquid-cooled rack-scale platform.

evidence.title: NVIDIA NVL72 AI Factory system hardware and components
evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA reports 4 B300 GPUs and 2 Grace CPUs per compute tray, 9 NVSwitch trays, 8 power shelves, and up to 142 kW per rack.

evidence.title: Illustrative shared capacity, yield, and stage throughput
evidence.excerpt: All shared capacity, yield, qualification, logistics, installation, and commissioning ranges linked here are synthetic.

evidence.title: Illustrative platform demand and allocation weights
evidence.excerpt: Demand ranges and priority weights are synthetic and do not represent orders or reserved capacity.

platform.name: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72

accelerator_packages_per_system.methodology: Treats each of the 72 disclosed GPUs as one accelerator package for the portfolio output metric.
accelerator_packages_per_system.confirming_evidence: A manufacturing BOM or current NVIDIA system specification supports the conversion.
accelerator_packages_per_system.falsifying_evidence: A manufacturing BOM uses a different package or module definition.

servers_per_system.methodology: Uses 18 compute trays as 18 complete server nodes per rack.
servers_per_system.confirming_evidence: A manufacturing BOM or current NVIDIA system specification supports the conversion.
servers_per_system.falsifying_evidence: A current rack specification reports a different compute-node count.

racks_per_system.methodology: The platform boundary is one NVL72 rack-scale system.
racks_per_system.confirming_evidence: A current NVIDIA BOM or service manual reports the same configuration.
racks_per_system.falsifying_evidence: The modeled system boundary changes from one rack.

platform.notes: Product configuration is source-backed; manufacturing package semantics remain a derived abstraction.

demand.methodology: Illustrative quarterly platform demand ceiling; not an order-book estimate.
demand.confirming_evidence: Customer commitments and delivery schedules support the demand range.
demand.falsifying_evidence: Cancellations, substitutions, or order evidence place demand outside the range.

priority_weight.methodology: Illustrative progressive-allocation weight; not an inferred contract priority.
priority_weight.confirming_evidence: Reserved capacity, prepayments, and supplier allocation records support the weight.
priority_weight.falsifying_evidence: Observed product mix or contractual priority conflicts with the weight.
